assertion.hard_failure: Blocks route selection, budget reservation and generation submission.

rules: A mutation is proposed by an approved episode/scene plan and committed only after the episode continuity-out review.
The before value must match the pinned parent snapshot.
Conflicting mutations create manual_review_required; last-write-wins is prohibited.
Generated visual evidence may support a mutation but cannot author narrative truth.

validation_stages.gate: All episode assumptions validate against continuity_in_state_id.
Scene character/location/prop/time assertions pass before shot planning.
Hard shot assertions pass against the pinned snapshot and canonical reference package hashes.
Machine checks compare the returned artifact with pinned visual/voice references and shot assertions.
Human-approved narrative mutations create a new immutable snapshot through compare-and-swap.

non_authority: The continuity engine does not rewrite scripts.
The continuity engine does not approve attractive but inconsistent shots.
The continuity engine does not infer approval from a successful generation or QC execution.
